ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:12; the visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 8% coverage of high-intensity (white) pixels primarily concentrated in linear marks and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-intensity field across both lobes. High-intensity white contiguous patch located on the distal tip of the right lobe. Discontinuous high-intensity linear bands (scratches) mapped across the central and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serration along both lobes. Notable deep irregular notch/indentation on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 1/3 the distance from the tip toward the notch. Tips show higher amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge sweep; lobes taper to pointed distal tips with a slight posterior orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-intensity white punctate marks on the far distal tip and trailing edge of the right lobe; likely consistent with barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting across the dark pigmentation of both lobes, particularly dense on the central-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the right lobe, inconsistent with standard serration frequency.
